g.text: - agentic GitHub issue creation by the workflow
- agentic empty GitHub repo creation by the workflow
- needs_revision goes back to the agent
- fixture mode for tests and E2E
- prod CRM writes: test venue only
- memory files: stack state, stage on prod SF
- wiki: decision page, hacks, tech debt, _log.md
- compaction summary to resume the session
- named agents keep context across turns
- red -> green, one scenario at a time
- not code review, not a gate
